theme_archetype.name: Cinematic Slate & Amber
theme_archetype.description: A highly functional, cinematic aesthetic inspired by Plex and Sonarr. Deep slate backgrounds paired with vibrant amber and emerald highlights ensure clarity while feeling premium and immersive. Avoids standard 'tech' purple/blue.

typography.installation: Ensure Google Fonts for 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' are imported.

grid.media_cards: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4 sm:gap-6

navigation.description: Sticky top navigation bar featuring the MediaHunt logo (Amber accent), search inputs/filters centered, and Settings/Language toggles on the right.

media_card.description: Container for torrent result. 2:3 aspect ratio. Image covers background.

states.default: Image visible, gradient overlay at bottom with Title and Year.
states.hover: Dark overlay (bg-black/70) slides in or fades in revealing 'Copy Magnet', 'Download .torrent', and 'Find Subtitles' buttons.
states.metadata: Top-right absolute badge for Quality (e.g., 4K, 1080p). Bottom edge shows Seeders (emerald) / Leechers (rose) and Size.

search_filters.description: Horizontal bar below header (or integrated). Dropdowns for: Type (Filme/Série/Anime), Language (Dublado PT-BR/Legendado/Original/Qualquer), Quality. Use Shadcn Select component.

disclaimer_banner.description: Fixed banner at the very bottom or top of the UI warning about responsible use. Subdued styling (bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 text-slate-400 text-xs) with a dismiss button.

settings_page.description: Dual-pane layout. Left: Vertical tabs (General, API Keys, Sources, Subtitles). Right: Forms and Toggles.
settings_page.toggles: Use Shadcn Switch for toggling YTS, Nyaa, 1337x. Implement basic drag/drop or up/down arrow buttons next to them to dictate priority.

subtitle_drawer.description: When clicking 'Find Subtitles' on a card, open a Shadcn Dialog or Sheet. Fetch from OpenSubtitles via backend. Show language badges (PT-BR, EN, etc.) and a 'Download' button.

loading_skeletons.description: Use Shadcn Skeleton. For cards: rounded-lg bg-slate-800 aspect-[2/3]. Animate pulse.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text, especially over poster images, has sufficient contrast. Use heavy linear-gradients on overlays.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements must have a data-testid. Examples: data-testid='search-input', data-testid='magnet-button', data-testid='settings-link'.

icons.usage: Use icons for Seeders (ArrowUp), Leechers (ArrowDown), Settings (Settings), Magnet (Magnet), Subtitles (MessageSquare), and Sources.

images.description: Fallback cinematic movie poster when API fails to provide one.
Abstract tech grid used for the empty search state or welcome banner.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind classes as defined in color_palette. Apply bg-[#0B0F19] to the main body.
Do NOT use pure black or white. Stick to the slate and amber combinations.
Prioritize Shadcn UI for dropdowns, dialogues, switches, and tabs.
Ensure the layout is responsive (grid changes from 2 cols on mobile to 6 on extra-large screens).
Include the data-testid attributes extensively as per requirements.
Respect the PT-BR default language requirement.
